reuse.why: Uses the shared extractTagsFromText tag parser and adds the rule to the existing getMonthActionCategories selection used by setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the average actions.

duplication.why: The tag rule is one predicate, but the notes join is added twice (getBudgetData and getMonthActionCategories) because copyPreviousMonth keeps its own pre-existing filtering path.

placement.why: The predicate and both filters live in budget/actions.ts beside the existing month-wide exclusions.

scope.why: Only the two selection paths and their tests are touched.

maintainability.why: A single named predicate keeps the rule in one place, though the two parallel selection paths (copyPreviousMonth vs getMonthActionCategories) still each have to remember to apply it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Both paths call isFixedGroupNote, built on #shared/tags extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated notes join is visible and left as is in the two existing selection paths, not reshaped.

one_place.where: budget/actions.ts isFixedGroupNote is the single definition of the #fixed rule, applied by getMonthActionCategories (setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg) and by copyPreviousMonth's getBudgetData filter.
